exam_name: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals
exam_price_notes: Check the official booking page for the price in your country or region.
renewal_options: Microsoft Fundamentals certifications do not expire and do not require renewal.
target_audience: Business stakeholder, New or existing IT professional, Student
recommended_experience: Familiar with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 and want to understand how Microsoft SCI solutions can span across these solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.

retake_policy.notes: After the first failure, wait 24 hours. Wait 14 days between later attempts. At most five attempts in the 12 months starting with the first attempt; after five failures, wait until that period ends. Retake fees apply. See Microsoft's policy for exceptions.

study_actions.title: Atlas study exercise: Separate identity and security functions
study_actions.detail: For an organization adopting cloud services, distinguish authentication, authorization, security monitoring and compliance needs. Map each need to the relevant capability in the guide. Explain the responsibility being addressed before selecting a Microsoft product. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
